title: Scale controls by action consequence class
narrative: High-consequence writes demand stronger controls and visible approval frequency; low-risk work need not nag. Accepts inspiration requirement 15[^insp-r15]. Contributes to personal-agent MH-PA-02; composed gate delta: `fangore_insp_authority_gate`[^insp-pa-02-risk].
implementation: `ConsequencePolicy` / `ActionConsequence` in `mechaharness.consequence` classify actions (`low`…`critical`), flag approval and exhaustive verification needs, and expose `approval_frequency` as a usability/safety metric. Grants in `AccessControl` remain the hard gate.
validation: Kind `consequence_risk_scale`. Soft expects: high-consequence write requires stronger controls; approval frequency recorded. Unit: `tests/test_inspiration_primitives.py`. Related grants: `fangore_insp_soft_vs_hard`.
